mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_node_statistics ( stat_date, api_code, link_id, link_node_id, total_count, total_magnitude, first_update_time, last_update_time, update_count ) VALUES ( #{statDate}, #{apiCode}, #{linkId}, #{linkNodeId}, #{totalCount}, #{totalMagnitude}, #{firstUpdateTime}, #{lastUpdateTime}, 1 )

INSERT INTO mk_node_statistics ( stat_date, api_code, link_id, link_node_id, total_count, total_magnitude, first_update_time, last_update_time, update_count ) SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, #{apiCode} AS api_code, #{linkId} AS link_id, #{linkNodeId} AS link_node_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(node_code, '|', api_code, '|', execution_time)) AS total_count, SUM(COALESCE(magnitude, 0)) AS total_magnitude, MIN(execution_time) AS first_update_time, MAX(execution_time) AS last_update_time, 1 AS update_count FROM mk_indicator WHERE DATE(execution_time) = #{statDate} AND api_code = #{apiCode} AND node_code = #{nodeCode} AND execution_time >= #{startTime} AND execution_time < #{endTime}
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(total_count) AS totalCount, SUM(total_magnitude) AS totalMagnitude, MIN(first_update_time) AS firstUpdateTime, MAX(last_update_time) AS lastUpdateTime, SUM(update_count) AS updateCount FROM mk_node_statistics WHERE link_id = #{linkId} AND stat_date = #{statDate}
